fragment.choose:
<when condition="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerPostCallMode", "enforce") == "off"
                       || (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerMode", "both") == "pre_call"
                       || context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerBlocked", false)
                       || context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerIsStreaming", false)
                       || context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerBodyOversize", false))">
        
      
      
        <set-variable name="straikerRespRaw" value="@{
            try { return context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true) ?? ""; }
            catch { return ""; }
        }" />
        
        
        <set-variable name="straikerPostEnvelope" value="@{
            var envelope = new JObject {
                ["eventType"] = "post_call",
                ["request"] = new JObject {
                    ["body"] = (JObject)context.Variables["straikerReqBody"],
                    ["text"] = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerPrompt", "")
                },
                ["response"] = new JObject {
                    ["stream"] = false,
                    ["body"]   = (JObject)context.Variables["straikerRespBody"],
                    ["text"]   = (string)context.Variables["straikerRespText"]
                },
                ["userInfo"] = new JObject {
                    ["id"]   = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerUserName", "apim"),
                    ["role"] = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerUserRole", "public")
                },
                ["consumer"] = new JObject {
                    ["appId"]     = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerAppId", "apim-policy"),
                    ["name"]      = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerAppDisplayName", "apim-policy"),
                    ["custom_id"] = context.Subscription != null ? context.Subscription.Id : ""
                },
                ["aiContext"] = new JObject {
                    ["llm_format"] = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerLlmFormat", "openai"),
                    ["model"] = new JObject {
                        ["name"] = (string)(((JObject)context.Variables["straikerRespBody"])["model"]
                                   ?? ((JObject)context.Variables["straikerReqBody"])["model"] ?? "unknown")
                    }
                },
                ["metadata"] = new JObject {
                    ["session_id"] = (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerSessionId", context.RequestId.ToString()),
                    ["trace_id"]   = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-trace-id", ""),
                    ["client_ip"]  = context.Request.IpAddress ?? "127.0.0.1",
                    ["gateway"]    = "azure-apim"
                }
            };
            return envelope.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
        }" />

        
          
            
            
              @((string)context.Variables["straikerWebhookUrl"])
              POST
              
                @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["straikerApiKey"])
              
              
                application/json
              
              
                @((string)context.Variables["straikerWebhookFormat"])
              
              
                true
              
              @((string)context.Variables["straikerPostEnvelope"])
            
          
          
            <send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="straikerPostResp"
                          timeout="@((int)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerTimeoutSec", 5))"
                          ignore-error="true">
              @((string)context.Variables["straikerWebhookUrl"])
              POST
              
                @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["straikerApiKey"])
              
              
                application/json
              
              
                @((string)context.Variables["straikerWebhookFormat"])
              
              
                true
              
              @((string)context.Variables["straikerPostEnvelope"])
            

            <set-variable name="straikerPostAction" value="@{
                var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerPostResp", null);
                if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return "__unavailable__"; }
                try {
                    var body = r.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                    var a = body["action"];
                    if (a == null || a.Type != JTokenType.String) { return "__unavailable__"; }
                    return ((string)a).ToLowerInvariant();
                } catch { return "__unavailable__"; }
            }" />
            <set-variable name="straikerPostTurnId" value="@{
                var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerPostResp", null);
                if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return ""; }
                try {
                    var body = r.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                    return (string)(body["turn_id"] ?? body["turnId"] ?? "");
                } catch { return ""; }
            }" />

            
            
              <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["straikerPostAction"] == "block"
                              && (string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerBlockMode", "http-403") == "openai-stub")">
                
                  
                  
                    application/json
                  
                  
                    block
                  
                  @{
                      var b = (JObject)context.Variables["straikerReqBody"];
                      var stub = new JObject {
                          ["id"] = "chatcmpl-straiker-blocked",
                          ["object"] = "chat.completion",
                          ["created"] = (long)(context.Timestamp - new DateTime(1970, 1, 1)).TotalSeconds,
                          ["model"] = (string)(b["model"] ?? "unknown"),
                          ["choices"] = new JArray {
                              new JObject {
                                  ["index"] = 0,
                                  ["message"] = new JObject {
                                      ["role"] = "assistant",
                                      ["content"] = "I'm sorry, I'm unable to process that request."
                                  },
                                  ["finish_reason"] = "stop"
                              }
                          },
                          ["usage"] = new JObject {
                              ["prompt_tokens"] = 0, ["completion_tokens"] = 0, ["total_tokens"] = 0
                          }
                      };
                      return stub.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                  }
                
              
              
                
                  
                  
                    application/json
                  
                  @{
                      var err = new JObject {
                          ["error"] = new JObject {
                              ["message"] = "Straiker: response blocked by policy (post-call). Final output withheld.",
                              ["turn_id"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerPostTurnId"],
                              ["phase"]   = "post_call",
                              ["code"]    = "403"
                          }
                      };
                      return err.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                  }
